<Heading as={'h1'} className={'openapi__heading'} children={'Turn encryption on or off'}></Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={'patch'}
  path={'/v1/admin/encryption'}
  context={'endpoint'}
></MethodEndpoint>

Turning it on generates a data key, wraps it under the key-encryption key and stores it; turning it off retires the active key. Neither takes effect instantly: for `ENCRYPTION_KEY_RING_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS` the previous state keeps governing new writes so every engine process learns of the change first. From the change onward the background sweep moves every stored onboarding toward the chosen state — encrypting plain JSON rows, or decrypting every row back to plain JSON — with no further operator action. Idempotent: asking for the state that already holds changes nothing. Returns the resulting state, as `GET` would.
